name: Kong Gateway
description: Shows the routes a Kong Gateway (OSS or Enterprise, DB-less or with a database) publishes: host names, the upstream service address and port, protocols (http, https, tcp) and whether a route is enabled. Netlens ties every route to the device or container behind it, can keep an HTTPS check per site and can register the host names in DNS. Read-only: it only sends GET requests to the Admin API.
author: Netlens
supports: Kong with a database and Kong Enterprise (not tested)

releases.changelog: First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
